tasks.label: waitForServiceDiscovery
args: for i in {1..30}; do if curl -s http://localhost:8761/actuator/health | grep -q '"status":"UP"'; then echo 'Service Discovery is ready'; exit 0; fi; echo "Attempt $i: Waiting for Service Discovery..."; sleep 2; done; echo 'Service Discovery failed to start within timeout'; exit 1

tasks.label: waitForGateway
args: for i in {1..30}; do if curl -s http://localhost:8080/actuator/health | grep -q '"status":"UP"'; then echo 'API Gateway is ready'; exit 0; fi; echo "Attempt $i: Waiting for API Gateway..."; sleep 2; done; echo 'API Gateway failed to start within timeout'; exit 1
